messages.色欲資源を溜めるほどダメージ量が伸び、火傷と出血の回数を増やす色欲打撃の3枠広域: A 3-target Lust Blunt E.G.O whose damage grows with stored Lust resources and that increases Burn and Bleed Count. In practice, it is for Bleed teams (assumes Threadspin Ⅴ).
messages.資源でダメージ量: 攻撃前、保有する色欲E.G.O資源1つにつきダメージ量+6%: **Damage from resources**: Before attacking, +6% damage per Lust E.G.O resource held, up to 120% at 20 resources.
messages.回数の上乗せ: 的中時に火傷回数と出血回数が各3増える。付与ではなく回数の増加な: **Adding Count**: On hit, increases Burn Count and Bleed Count by 3 each. It increases Count rather than inflicting, so Burn or Bleed likely needs to be applied first. It also gains +1 Final Power for every 4 combined Burn and Bleed, up to 3.
messages.色欲威力増加の配布: 色欲資源6つにつき、編成順に味方1名へ次のターンに色欲威力: **Distributing Lust Power Up**: For every 6 Lust resources, gives 1 ally, in team order, 1 Lust Power Up next turn, up to 5 allies.
messages.パッシブ「暴食のるつぼ」: ターン開始時に色欲以外の資源1つを色欲資源1つへ変換: **Passive — Cauldron of Gorging**: At Turn Start, converts 1 non-Lust resource into 1 Lust resource. With 20 or more Lust resources, it does not convert, and she gains 1 Lust Power Up instead. Note that other resources decrease while below 20.
messages.色欲資源を20個近く貯めてから撃つ。色欲のスキルが多い出血編成が前提で、資源を引: Fire it after storing close to 20 Lust resources. It assumes a Bleed team with many Lust skills and likely shines on battlefields where resources carry over.
Early on, when resources are short, the passive turns scarce resources such as Gloom into Lust, making other E.G.O harder to use.
messages.侵蝕スキルは破壊不能コインで、色欲共鳴数×2(最大8)の資源を消費し、消費1つに: The Corrosion skill uses Unbreakable Coins, consumes (Lust Resonance×2) resources, up to 8, and gains +20% damage per resource consumed. Its resource consumption is heavy.
messages.必要資源は色欲5、精神消耗は覚醒20。: It requires 5 Lust, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放される。資源が減る副作用だけが先に来るため、Ⅱで止めるならⅠ: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive. Only the resource-draining side effect arrives first, so if you stop at Ⅱ, staying at Ⅰ is likely better.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力、ダメージ量の上限、火傷回数の付与が伸びる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, the damage cap, and Burn Count infliction.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒・侵蝕とも攻撃加重値が3になる。: **Ⅳ**: Both Awakening and Corrosion reach 3 Attack Weight.
messages.Ⅴ: 出血回数の増加と最終威力強化、色欲威力増加の配布が加わり、ダメージ量の上限: **Ⅴ**: Adds Bleed Count increase, Final Power Up, and Lust Power Up distribution, and raises the damage cap from 50% to 120%. The passive improves from converting 2 resources to 1.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド室長: 出血を扱い、色欲のスキルを複数持つので資源を出しやすい: **[The Manager of La Manchaland](persona:0310)**: Uses Bleed and has several Lust skills, making resources easy to supply.
messages.LCB囚人: 刺す(色欲)で色欲資源を出せ、束ね刺しと正義のため!が出血を付与す: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0301)**: Joust (Lust) supplies Lust resources, and Galloping Tilt and For Justice! inflict Bleed.
